title: SMS/MMS
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://dev.dengage.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

Marketing SMS and MMS content in Dengage is the message text (and, for MMS, one media file) that you reuse in campaigns and flows. You create the content once under **Content > Marketing > SMS/MMS**, get it approved, then send it from a one-time campaign, a recurring campaign or a flow node.

This guide covers the whole task in order: what to set up first, how the list works, how to create and edit content, how to test it, how to personalize it, and how to send it. SMS and MMS share the same screen and the same steps; the MMS differences are marked where they occur.

> 📘
>
> This page covers marketing messages. Messages triggered by an event for one contact at a time (order confirmations, one-time passwords, delivery updates) are transactional content and live under **Content > Transactional**. See the Transactional SMS guide for those.

## Prerequisites   [Skip link to Prerequisites](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#prerequisites)

| Requirement | Why it matters |
| --- | --- |
| An SMS provider integration | Messages are sent through the provider connected to your account. Each sender name in the content editor belongs to a provider, shown as "Sender - provider". |
| At least one sender name | The sender name is the header your customers see at the top of the message. If the Sender Name list is empty, no sender is set up for your account. |
| Content and publish permissions for your role | Creating and editing content needs the content permission. Publishing needs the publish permission. Without it, your content waits for approval. See Roles and Permissions. |
| MMS only: an MMS-capable provider | The MMS option stays greyed out until MMS is enabled for your account. Not every SMS provider supports MMS. |
| Optional: a predefined test audience | A saved test list lets you send test messages without typing numbers each time. |

## Limits at a glance   [Skip link to Limits at a glance](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#limits-at-a-glance)

| Item | Limit |
| --- | --- |
| Message length per language | 400 characters |
| Characters outside the ANSI set | Each counts as 2 (for example Turkish letters such as ş and ğ, and emojis) |
| Concatenated SMS | Enabled by default. A message longer than one SMS part is split and delivered as one message on the phone. The counter shows the number of parts. |
| MMS media file | JPEG, PNG or GIF, maximum 400 KB, 2:1 aspect ratio recommended |

## Open the SMS/MMS list   [Skip link to Open the SMS/MMS list](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#open-the-smsmms-list)

1. In the left menu, click **Content**.
2. Under **Marketing**, click **SMS/MMS**. The list opens at the **All** view.

![_The SMS content list in Dengage showing the All, Created by me and Test Logs views on the left, folders below them, and the content table with Type, Name, Status, Last Edited On, Last Edited By and Languages columns._](https://files.readme.io/d4091130b88c92084fd48033ba8a5bd7f603fb68401e7126adda31244e3a1e88-Screenshot_2026-09-28_at_14.04.32.png)

_The SMS/MMS list. Use the left panel to switch views and folders, and the table to open or manage content._

### Views, folders, search and filter   [Skip link to Views, folders, search and filter](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#views-folders-search-and-filter)

- **All** shows every SMS and MMS content. **Created by me** shows only yours. **Test Logs** shows every test message sent from this screen (see Preview and test).
- **Folders** keep content organised. Click **New Folder** to add one. Use the three-dot menu next to a folder to manage it. New content goes to the default **SMS Content** folder unless you change the folder.
- **Search** by name in the box above the table.
- **Filter** by **Languages**, **Date Range** (by update date or by create date) and **Message Type** (All, SMS, MMS). Click **Apply**, or **Clear Filter** to reset.
- **Sort** by clicking the **Name** or **Last Edited On** column header. Click again to reverse.

### Statuses   [Skip link to Statuses](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#statuses)

| Status | Meaning | Usable in a campaign? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Draft** | Saved but not published. | No |
| **Waiting** | Sent for approval by a user without publish permission. A user with publish permission must approve it. | No |
| **Approved** | Published and ready to use. | Yes |

### Row actions   [Skip link to Row actions](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#row-actions)

Click the three-dot menu at the end of a row:

- **Create Campaign**: opens the campaign wizard with this content selected. See Send it.
- **Edit**: opens the content. See Edit content.
- **Duplicate**: creates a copy of the content.
- **Move**: moves the content to another folder.
- **Copy Public ID**: copies the content's public ID, the identifier used to refer to this content from other parts of the platform.
- **Delete**: removes the content after you confirm.

![_The row action menu on the SMS list showing Create Campaign, Edit, Duplicate, Move, Copy Public ID and Delete. Caption: Row actions for a single content._](https://files.readme.io/130c9f1005936668b29fe8ebfea441c524832568f400f679994c843538d92db8-Screenshot_2026-09-28_at_14.43.43.png)

_Row actions for a single content._

## Create content   [Skip link to Create content](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#create-content)

Creating takes two cards: **General** (name, description, folder) and **Content** (type, languages, sender, message, link settings). You can save a draft at any point.

### Step 1: Fill in General   [Skip link to Step 1: Fill in General](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-1-fill-in-general)

1. Click **New** in the top right of the list.
2. In **Name**, type a name your team can find later. Customers do not see it.
3. (Optional) In **Description**, note the purpose, campaign or owner.
4. In **Folder**, keep the default or click **Change Folder**.
5. Click **Next**. The Content card opens. Click the pencil icon on the General card at any time to change these values.

![_The General card of a new SMS content with Name, Description and Folder fields and a Next button, with an empty phone preview on the right_](https://files.readme.io/c7d3e3caf8f46f6a0a3fe16f2123ec6a55ca8154090a27331e9bf47f78c40cae-Screenshot_2026-09-28_at_15.59.21.png)

_Name the content and choose its folder._

### Step 2: Choose the message type   [Skip link to Step 2: Choose the message type](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-2-choose-the-message-type)

Under **Message Type**, select **SMS** (text only) or **MMS** (text plus one media file). MMS is greyed out when MMS is not enabled for your account.

> 🚧
>
> ### The message type is locked once you save the content. To switch, create a new content.   [Skip link to The message type is locked once you save the content. To switch, create a new content.](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#the-message-type-is-locked-once-you-save-the-content-to-switch-create-a-new-content)

**If you chose MMS:** a **Multimedia** field appears above the message. Choose **URL** and paste the file link in **Source URL**, or choose **Upload**, click **Select** and pick a JPEG, PNG or GIF up to 400 KB. A 2:1 aspect ratio is recommended. Select the sender name again after switching to MMS; the field resets.

![_he Content card with Message Type set to MMS and the Multimedia field showing URL and Upload options, a Select button and the note "Maximum allowed size is 400 KB (JPEG, PNG or GIF)_](https://files.readme.io/0898fd6af1f82c62724ca63eddfd4964fe8947cd501c185e0b617e7e347aad21-Screenshot_2026-09-28_at_16.16.23.png)

_Step 2 for MMS. Add the media by URL or upload._

### Step 3: Add languages (optional)   [Skip link to Step 3: Add languages (optional)](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-3-add-languages-optional)

A content can hold one message per language.

1. Click **Add Languages**.
2. Choose **Copy from Content** to start from another SMS content, or **Create Blank Content** to start empty.
3. In **Select Language**, tick the languages you need and click **Apply**. English is selected by default.
4. Fill in the sender and message for each language.

### Step 4: Select the sender name   [Skip link to Step 4: Select the sender name](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-4-select-the-sender-name)

In **Sender Name**, pick the header your customers see at the top of the message. Options are listed as "Sender - provider" because each sender name belongs to a provider integration.

### Step 5: Write the message   [Skip link to Step 5: Write the message](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-5-write-the-message)

1. Type in the **Message** box. The phone preview on the right updates as you type.
2. Watch the counter below the box, for example **53 / 400 Characters · 1 SMS**. The number after the dot is how many SMS parts the message uses. See Limits at a glance for how characters are counted.

Three icons sit in the top right of the message box:

- **Zeki AI assistant** (sparkle icon): opens the AI panel with **Improve Writing**, **Make Shorter**, **Make Longer**, a brand persona selector and **Enter New Prompt**.
- **Add Customization** (code icon): inserts a personalization tag. See Personalize the message.
- **Emoji**: inserts an emoji. Each emoji counts as two characters.

![_The Content card with a sender name selected, a message typed in the Message box, the three icons for AI assistant, customization and emoji, the counter reading 53 / 400 Characters 1 SMS, the Concatenated SMS Enabled badge and the Shorten and track links toggle. _](https://files.readme.io/51ea261ccbc3f6d491ac37a0bd61dcb8d304bf6853a673d3ed22921a15b31e12-Screenshot_2026-09-28_at_16.30.26.png)

_The message box, counter and link toggle._

### Step 6: Shorten and track links (optional)   [Skip link to Step 6: Shorten and track links (optional)](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-6-shorten-and-track-links-optional)

Turn on **Shorten and track links** to replace every URL in the message with a short link from the Dengage URL Shortener Service. The preview shows the short form. Short links save characters and let you track clicks.

### Step 7: Save or publish   [Skip link to Step 7: Save or publish](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#step-7-save-or-publish)

- **Save Draft** keeps the content as Draft.
- **Publish** makes it usable. With publish permission the status becomes Approved; without it, the status becomes Waiting until a user with publish permission approves it.
- **Cancel** leaves without saving.

### Worked example   [Skip link to Worked example](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#worked-example)

| Field | Example |
| --- | --- |
| Name | Autumn Sale - Reminder - EN |
| Folder | Promotions |
| Message Type | SMS |
| Languages | English (default), Turkish |
| Sender Name | BRAND - providername |
| Message (EN) | Hi {{contact.name}}, our autumn sale ends Sunday. 20% off everything: [https://www.example.com/autumn](https://www.example.com/autumn) Reply STOP to opt out. |
| Shorten and track links | On |

## Edit content   [Skip link to Edit content](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#edit-content)

What you can change depends on the status and on your publish permission.

- **Draft** opens directly in edit mode. Change any field except the message type, then Save Draft or Publish.
- **Approved** opens read-only on the **Current Content** tab. Click the **Edit Content** tab and choose **Copy Current Content** (start from the live text) or **Create From Scratch**. Users with publish permission can publish the edited version directly; other users send it for approval.

The header of an open content also offers **More** (Copy Public ID, Duplicate Template, Delete), **Create Campaign** and **Preview & Test**. The pencil icon next to the name changes the name, description or folder.

## Preview and test   [Skip link to Preview and test](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#preview-and-test)

1. Open the content and click **Preview & Test**.
2. The **Test SMS Template** dialog shows the message for a sample contact, with personalization filled in, plus the **Length**, the **No Of SMS** (parts) and the sender name. Click **Show Another** to preview with a different contact.
3. Click **Send Test SMS**. Under **Select Test Audience** choose **Predefined Audience** (a saved test list) or **Type-in Gsm** (type numbers), then click **Send**.

To confirm a test went out, click **Test Logs** in the left panel of the list. Pick a date range and, optionally, a GSM number, then click **Search**. Each row shows the Log ID, Content, Message, GSM List, Predefined List, Send Date and Sender.

## Personalize the message   [Skip link to Personalize the message](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#personalize-the-message)

1. Place the cursor where the value should appear.
2. Click the **Add Customization** (code) icon.
3. Pick a tab, search for the column and click it. The tag is inserted.

Tabs in the Customization Selector: **Contact Columns**, **Device Columns**, **Dynamic Contents (Plain Text)**, **Columns From Segment**, **Columns From Remote Segment**, **Columns From Table** and **System**.

For conditions, default values and formatting, use the Advanced Personalization syntax described in the developer guide. Use Preview & Test to check the real length after personalization.

> 📘
>
> ### Customization does not work in alternative messages, which are static.   [Skip link to Customization does not work in alternative messages, which are static.](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#customization-does-not-work-in-alternative-messages-which-are-static)

## Writing tips   [Skip link to Writing tips](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#writing-tips)

SMS has no formatting, so clarity comes from the words. Write in plain language and short sentences. Avoid whole words in capital letters. Put the most important information first. Use emojis sparingly, and remember each one counts as two characters. Include a clear opt-out instruction where regulation requires it.

## Send it   [Skip link to Send it](https://dev.dengage.com/docs/sms\#send-it)

Approved marketing content can be sent in two ways:

- **Create Campaign** from the row menu or the content header: the campaign wizard opens with this content selected. Choose one-time or recurring, set the audience, exclusions, control group, permissions, contact extension and duplicate handling, review the content, then set the schedule, hourly capping, conversion and visit tracking, drop conditions, and Google Analytics UTM parameters. See the SMS campaign guide for each setting.
- **Flow node**: in a flow, add the SMS / MMS send node and pick the content. MMS content sits under its own tab in the node.

Marketing content is not used by the Transactional API. For event-triggered messages, create the content under Content > Transactional.

Results appear under SMS/MMS Analytics.
